messages.content: 你能幫我為我和朋友共10位計劃在華盛頓州西雅圖的一天嗎？我們都是美食愛好者，想要嘗試一些海鮮和意大利菜作為午餐。晚上，我們有興趣參加一場音樂會或體育賽事。你能幫我找到適合我們的餐廳和活動嗎？

function.name: restaurant_find_group
function.description: Find restaurants suitable for groups based on specified criteria such as location and cuisine. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. Seattle, WA

cuisine.description: Preferred cuisine at the restaurant. Default is all if not specified.

group_size.description: Size of the group that the restaurant should accommodate.

function.name: events_find_event
function.description: Find events suitable for groups based on specified criteria such as location and event type. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. Seattle, WA

event_type.description: Type of event. Default is all if not specified.

group_size.description: Size of the group that the event should accommodate.

message.reasoning: The user wants to plan a day in Seattle for a group of 10. They want lunch with seafood or Italian. Then an evening event: concert or sports. We need to find restaurants suitable for groups based on location and cuisine. Also find events suitable for groups based on location and event type. We have two functions: restaurant_find_group and events_find_event. We need to call them. The user didn't specify a specific cuisine preference? They said "some seafood and Italian". So we can search for both. We can call restaurant_find_group twice: once for seafood, once for Italian. Or we can pass both cuisines? The function signature says cuisine?: "Seafood" | "Italian" | "Chinese"[] - but that seems ambiguous. It might accept an array of cuisines. But the type says "cuisine?: "Seafood" | "Italian" | "Chinese"[]" which is weird. It might be a union of string or array. We'll pass an array ["Seafood", "Italian"]. For group_size 10. For location "Seattle, WA". Then call events_find_event with location "Seattle, WA", event_type ["Concert", "Sports"], group_size 10. Then we can return the results. The user wants us to find suitable restaurants and events. So we should call the functions.
